description:
A GNOME Shell extension that displays real-time blood glucose levels in the top panel. Supports both Dexcom Share and Nightscout as data sources. Features customizable urgent high/low thresholds, color schemes, trend arrows, delta values, and comprehensive glucose monitoring options.

This extension is not affiliated, funded, or in any way associated with Dexcom or Nightscout.
name: Dexcom Blood Glucose Monitor
